content.what_it_is: MATLAB script plotting 1D transects of surface elevation for the FUNWAVE-TVD meteo_tsunami simple case. Loads eta_00001 from a hard-coded personal directory (L2, L4) to get grid dimensions (L6); dx=dy=500.0 m (L7-L8), coordinates x, y (L9-L10). For six snapshots nfile=[11 16 21 26 31 36] (L13) labeled min={'1.0'..'3.5'} hours (L14), loads eta_<fnum> (L24-L25) and plots row 50 transect eta(50,:) against x in a 6x1 subplot stack (L27-L28) with axis [0 300000 -0.5 1] (L29), grid (L30), per-panel title ' Time = <min> hr ' (L32), ylabel 'eta (m)' (L35), xlabel only on the last panel (L37-L39). Figure is 6x8 inches (L16-L18); renderer forced to zbuffer inside the loop (L42). Nothing is saved to file.
entities: eta loaded elevation array L4 (re-loaded per snapshot L25)
min cell array of hour labels L14 (shadows builtin min)
unresolved: transect row index 50 (L28) is hard-coded; its physical y location (50*dy=25 km if 1-based offset ignored) relative to the meteo forcing track is not determinable from this file
hour labels imply snapshot spacing of 5 files = 0.5 hr, i.e. 360 s output interval, but the case input.txt is needed to confirm
variable min (L14) shadows the MATLAB builtin
y (L10) is computed but unused; no print/save so figures are display-only
